page_title: RAY 1-1 ATM | Rayo Vallecano v Atletico Madrid 22/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Augusto Batalla, who smothers the ball.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.

89' Augusto Batalla was forced into action to thwart Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
88' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
85' Substitution. Alexander Sorloth makes his way off the pitch and Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
85' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Isi Palazon will be replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano).
85' The game has come to an end for Jorge de Frutos. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).

83' James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Jan Oblak has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
82' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
81' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Atl. Madrid will take a corner kick.
80' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) works the corner short.
79' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
78' James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Sergio Camello, but Jan Oblak displays great awareness to stop him.

76' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
73' Substitution. Randy Nteka did his best and is replaced by James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano).
72' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
70' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

69' That didn't go as planned. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal was too weak to get past Jan Oblak, who easily kept it out.
65' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Unai Lopez.
65' Here's the change. Adrian Embarba leaves the pitch and Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as a substitute.

65' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Mario Melero Lopez blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
62' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
61' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is cleared to safety by the defence.
60' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a long ball in, but Jan Oblak comfortably gathers the ball.
58' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find Alexander Sorloth, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
56' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul and Mario Melero Lopez immediately signals a free kick.
55' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
51' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
49' 1 - 1 Goal! Alexander Sorloth plays a short, square pass into the path of Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 1:1. Fabulous goal!
49' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) tries to find Pep Chavarria, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
48' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Diego Simeone gives a chance to Antoine Griezmann and Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is off.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) comes off for Angel Correa.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
45+1' The ball falls for Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there!
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Cesar Azpilicueta limps off the pitch to be replaced by Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid).
45' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
42' Koke (Atl. Madrid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
42' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Atl. Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atl. Madrid.
41' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) tackles a bit over-zealously and Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Atl. Madrid.
39' Total attempts – 8:5. The number of shots on goal at present is 2:2.

35' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Mario Melero Lopez signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Rayo Vallecano players celebrate. Goal! Andrei Ratiu passes the ball to the feet of Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 1:0.
35' Wait! Referee Mario Melero Lopez immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
35' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
33' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

33' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked. The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner.
33' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
31' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
31' A pass from Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Jan Oblak and the move breaks down.
28' The shot by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Augusto Batalla.
28' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

25' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.

25' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for an infringement. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
22' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

22' That was absolutely fantastic! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the crossbar! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
21' Rayo Vallecano force their opponents to concede a corner.
18' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
17' Koke (Atl. Madrid) brings his opponent down. Mario Melero Lopez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Rayo Vallecano.

15' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there.

14' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the top right corner is denied by a decent save from Augusto Batalla.
14' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. A free kick to Atl. Madrid.

10' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Mario Melero Lopez with no other option than to blow for a foul.
8' The foul by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) was seen by Mario Melero Lopez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.

5' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
4' Chance! Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but Augusto Batalla is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
3' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) tries to find Adrian Embarba, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
Mario Melero Lopez was nominated as the referee for this game.
